brief: Green tape to start the week, driven by geopolitical optimism ahead of the UN General Assembly and reports of "very successful" US-China talks before Thursday's Trump/Xi summit. Tech leads (NDX +237bps > SPX +124bps > RTY +66bps); breadth improves (325 SPX names green) but SPX ex-AI is only +20bps, so the gain concentrates in AI names. META +8.9% (+16% over 9 sessions) drives roughly 15% of the SPX move as its Meta Muse app hit No. 1 on the US App Store (~73,000 daily downloads over its first 10 days), lifting inference-demand beneficiaries INTC, AMD and ARM. AI-theme baskets (NeoClouds, optical, agentic AI, AI semis, data centers, Mag7) and retail-sensitive baskets (bitcoin, memes, retail favorites) are all higher. Squeeze dynamics continue post-Fed in high-beta losers and the most-shorted names, consistent with GS prime-brokerage data showing the largest net buying in five weeks, 60% from macro-product short covers and 40% from single-stock long buys; both hedge funds and long-onlys are net buyers. Chart of the Day: fewer than 30% of S&P names sit above their 50-day average despite the headline rally.
